audit.whatIsWrong: The recorded defect for this matchup is that the level chart and the prose disagree. The chart gives Ambessa Level 3, Levels 4-5 and First item, but whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all describe Mordekaiser winning those exact stages.
audit.why: Chart says Mordekaiser, Skill, Ambessa, Ambessa, Mordekaiser, Ambessa, Ambessa — four stages to Ambessa, matching her 52.65% over 452 games. The prose on three of her four stages said the opposite. The chart is the side supported by the data, so the whys were what needed fixing.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] so each states why Ambessa holds that stage, grounded in Indestructible's 12s cycle and Death's Grasp's 16s at rank 1. Left every side and rating untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike is described qualitatively — 'his cooldowns', 'once that E is down', 'with his R up' — with no numbers anywhere, including for the two ultimates that define level 6.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100 and Public Execution is 130/115/100. At rank 1 hers comes back ten seconds sooner, which is the one structural edge she has at 6. The other numbers that matter: Obliterate 8/7/6/5/4 at 675 range, Indestructible 12/11/10/9/8, Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8 at 700 range.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, mid, whys[1], whys[3], whys[4], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible is described as 'his W braces for a shield then heals'. That misses the half of it that changes how you trade.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.' Damage you put into him is what builds the shield you then have to break. Against a burst pattern that is a feedback loop — the harder you commit, the bigger the thing you have to chew through, and then he converts it to health. Grievous Wounds on the consume is the item answer; leaving before he cashes it is the mechanical one.
audit.corrected: Stated in wants.you[0], wants.foe[1], mid, whys[3] and whys[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Darkness Rise is never named, so nothing tells the player what the wind-up to his damage actually looks like.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.' It is a counter, not a cooldown — deny him the third connection and the aura never turns on, and the move speed that lets him stay glued to you never arrives either. That is the concrete version of 'keep trades short'.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Your R passive (flat armor pen + healing on ability damage)' is stated four times and is the entire reason the entry says Ambessa reclaims the lane at two items.
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text: 'blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.' No passive, no penetration, no healing. Against the champion whose win condition is out-sustaining you, telling the player their ultimate heals them through it is exactly backwards.
audit.corrected: Removed from spikes[3].text, wants.you[2], late and whys[6], replaced with Grievous Wounds and the short-trade discipline that actually beats Indestructible.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text says her Q cone 'doubles on the outer edge'.
audit.why: Riot's Cunning Sweep text: she 'sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades'. Bonus damage for the blades, no edge sweetspot and no multiplier stated anywhere.

edits.before: This is his stretch, not yours. Your cooldowns are longest at 4-5 and his whole kit wants the long fight — his W braces for a shield then heals, and the longer you stay glued to him the more your burst bleeds out to his grind. At 6, Realm of Death is the single scariest button: it yanks you into an isolated 1v1 and steals your stats, and since most of your kit is physical that duel guts your damage. Never all-in him near full HP with his R up — play for short Q-into-empowered-auto pokes, farm the wave, and respect that he flips any extended trade. Hold your own R as a disengage or a clean execute setup, not as a brawl-opener into his ult.

edits.before: By 2+ items it swings back to Ambessa's favor — your R passive gives flat armor pen plus healing on every ability hit, which finally answers his W sustain, and Eclipse with your Q-max lets you chain Q-cone into empowered auto into Sundering Slam to chunk him and dash off before his shield-amp and heal matter. Build a Quicksilver/QSS so his realm can't isolate you, and be honest: he never stops winning the LONG fight, so this lane is decided by whether you keep every trade short and clean. Group on the map where his single-target R is far less oppressive, never let him drag you off alone into a side lane, and use your R's blink-suppress to pick HIM off rather than dueling into his.

notes: The recorded level-chart defect resolves in the chart's favour: four stages to Ambessa matches her 52.65% over 452 games, and it was the whys prose on three of those stages that claimed Mordekaiser was winning. I aligned the prose and left every side and rating alone. The other load-bearing error was 'your R passive (flat armor pen + healing on ability damage)', stated four times — Public Execution has no passive, no penetration and no healing, and against the one champion whose plan is out-sustaining you that invented heal is the worst possible thing to believe. Indestructible's real rule (it stores damage he DEALS AND TAKES) makes committing harder rather than easier, which flips the itemisation call towards Grievous Wounds. UNVERIFIED and left in place untouched: the existing 'hold a Quicksilver/QSS so Realm of Death can't lock you' advice. Whether QSS or cleanse answers Realm of Death is not in the kit data — needsResearch is empty for cleansable — so I neither removed it nor restated it as fact.
